AUTHOR: Li
TITLE: An Automatic Detection and Statistical Method for Underwater Fish Based on Foreground Region Convolution Network (FR-CNN)
VENUE: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
REGION: Dongji Island, Zhongjieshan Islands National Marine Ranch, Zhoushan, Zhejiang, China (122.69 E, 30.19 N)
SPECIES: Thamnaconus modestus, Microcanthus strigatus, Oplegnathus fasciatus (+ 'unidentified fish' and 'water plants' classes)
DATA: Own submarine-cable observatory video (OTWHC-500 camera with supplementary lights), Dongji Island: 8,000 annotated frames from Nov 2020; additional 1,000 (text also says 2,000) annotated frames from Dec 2020-Jan 2021
V_EV: Fig. 1: '(c) The relatively turbid water environment'; Table 5: 'Water depth (m) 11.762 13.367 12.835'; Fig. 9: 'mAPIoU = 0.5 of three detection networks in different months' (Nov/Dec/Jan lens fouling)
D_EV: Sec. 3.1: '5600 annotated images are randomly selected for training ... while the remaining 2400 annotated images are reserved for validating'
R_EV: Sec. 3.1: frames 'from the underwater monitoring videos of Dongji Island in December 2020 and January 2021'; YOLOv5/Faster R-CNN 'maximum decrease of 5%' vs FR-CNN 'only 1%'
C_EV: NR: no score threshold (only 'confidence scores ... consistently above 0.85', p.15) and no duplicate control; counts are replaced by a time-averaged occurrence frequency (p.16)
E_EV: Sec. 3.2 / Figs. 10-11: 'daily and hourly average statistical results of the occurrence frequency of three fish species'; Table 6: 'Correlation coefficients between the activity of three kinds of fish and the hourly average of seawater environmental factors'
ARCH: FR-CNN: single-scale block Gaussian background model generates foreground candidate boxes (multiscale augmentation alpha = 0.5/2/5) fed to anchor-free two-stage ResNet-50-FPN detector (Detectron2 hyperparameters); compared with Faster R-CNN+FPN and YOLOv5
METR: mAP@IoU0.5, per-class AP, inference FPS, mAP by month (Nov 2020-Jan 2021), time-averaged occurrence frequency (fish/s), Pearson correlations with temperature/salinity/pH/chlorophyll/DO
NOTE: Main split is random frame-level 70/30 of 8,000 frames from one month of continuous video (D_ALL = N; adjacent-frame leakage not discussed). Temporal external test on Dec 2020 / Jan 2021 frames with progressive lens sediment/algae fouling; the text inconsistently says 1000 and 2000 extra frames. R3 = Y coded on the assumption that R3 means the performance change under shift is quantified (Fig. 9: max 5% vs 1% mAP drop). Water-quality sensors report temperature, salinity, pH, chlorophyll, DO and depth but no turbidity; turbidity/lens fouling described only qualitatively, so V1 = 정성 서술만 and V6 = P (month strata). No confidence threshold stated (only 'confidence scores ... consistently above 0.85'); C5 coded as duplicate-count handling because the paper explicitly rejects raw counts due to re-entry/re-matching and substitutes a time-averaged occurrence frequency; a stricter reader may code C5 = 없음 (giving C_ALL = NR). Ecological outputs (activity level/relative abundance time series, diel patterns, environmental correlations) have no comparison with manual counts or independent reference. NCLASS 5 includes 'water plants' and 'unidentified fish' detection classes; 3 target species. FPS = Y refers to the 1 FPS sampling for statistics; native frame rate not explicitly given. ENV coded 온대 암반/켈프 for an open-sea artificial-reef marine ranch in Zhoushan.
